ref: ADR-0025 "Data errors name their box" (Q10) and ADR-0005: a number is read in the xs:decimal lexical form only, anything else is err:FORG0001 at the box; a box parameter that is a number follows the same rule, and is checked whatever the data (#75)
note: index{initial=one}: its initial value is no xs:decimal, so index raises err:FORG0001 at its box F1, though o1 has no Sku to number.
